transcript: Speaker A: Sach sach bata Priya, promotion hard work se mila ya English se? [Tell the truth Priya, did you get the promotion because of hard work or English?] Speaker B: Mujhe lagta hai English se hi. [I think because of English.] Speaker C: Dono se. [From both.] Speaker B: Waise Priya, kya sach mein teri English itni achhi hai? [By the way Priya, is your English really that good?] Speaker C: Meri bhi English pehle bahut weak thi kyunki main bhi Hindi medium se hi padhi hoon na. Meeting mein bolne se darr lagta tha. Saare words idhar udhar jaate the. Phir maine SpeakX app try kiya. [My English was also very weak earlier because I also studied in Hindi medium. I used to be scared of speaking in meetings. All the words would go here and there. Then I tried the SpeakX app.] Speaker A: SpeakX app? [SpeakX app?] Speaker C: Haan, is app mein maine AI teachers ke saath real English conversations practice kari. Aur agar koi grammar mistake ho na, toh AI teachers turant correct kar dete hain. [Yes, on this app I practiced real English conversations with AI teachers. And if there is any grammar mistake, the AI teachers correct it immediately.] Speaker B: Lekin English seekhne mein toh kaafi time lagta hai na? [But learning English takes a lot of time, right?] Speaker C: Bilkul nahi. Roz 10 se 15 minutes is app pe practice karo aur 15 se 20 dinon mein ekdum fluent English bolna seekh jaoge. [Not at all. Practice 10 to 15 minutes daily on this app and in 15 to 20 days you will learn to speak fluent English.] Speaker A: Par kahan yaar, hamari salary aapki tarah thodi na hai ki app use kar payen. [But where, friend, our salary is not like yours that we can use the app.] Speaker C: Sirf Rs 2 mein 7 din ka trial le sakte ho. [You can take a 7-day trial for just Rs 2.] Speaker B: Arey wah, ab next promotion mera. [Oh wow, now the next promotion is mine.] Speaker A: Nahi, nahi mera. [No, no mine.] Speaker C: Haan, toh uske liye pehle SpeakX app download karo. [Yes, so for that first download the SpeakX app.]
